title: Intrinsic Sequentiality in P: Causal Limits of Parallel Computation
summary: We study a polynomial-time decision problem in which each input encodes a depth-$N$ causal execution in which a single non-duplicable token must traverse an ordered sequence of steps, revealing at most $O(1)$ bits of routing information at each step. The uncertainty in the problem lies in identifying the delivery path through the relay network rather than in the final accept/reject outcome, which is defined solely by completion of the prescribed execution.
